title: Tripura Buranji: Diplomatic Missions from King Rudra Singha to King Ratna Manikya
title_english: Tripura Buranji: Diplomatic Missions from King Rudra Singha to King Ratna Manikya
title_as: ত্ৰিপুৰা বুৰঞ্জী: স্বৰ্গদেউ ৰুদ্ৰসিংহৰ কটকীৰ ত্ৰিপুৰা যাত্ৰা
title_tai: ပိုၼ်းမိူင်း တိပူႇရႃႇ ၽွင်း တမၢၼ်ႇ ၸဝ်ႈၾႃႉ ဢႃႇႁူမ်ႇ သူင်ႇ လိၵ်ႈ ၵတိ

provenance: Department of Historical and Antiquarian Studies (DHAS), Assam, Gauhati; Archive ID tripura-buranji
description: Eyewitness diplomatic record kept by the Ahom royal envoys Ratna Kandali Sarma and Arjundas Bairagi, sent by Swargadeo Rudra Singha between 1710 and 1715 A.D. to forge a grand inter-kingdom confederacy with King Ratna Manikya of Tripura, recording riverine navigation, court protocol, and mutual royal oaths.
